decision: Thirty-two existing scoped monographs/studies are accepted as current provisional interpretations at their recorded boundaries. Initial body bytes remain exact; machine authority is made explicit with a complete quartet and a visible adoption notice. This is not a blanket maturity, tier, identity, discovery-enrollment or capability decision.

receiving.reviewer: Separately delegated authority reviewer, same AI lineage; all32 substantive bodies received, introduction/middle/conclusion and major actor/relationship references checked.
receiving.root_acceptance_scope: Complete transferred adoption arguments, controlling qualifications and exact inheritance of previously received and published substantive bodies. New authority decision; no fresh raw-source completeness or statistically independent validation claimed.

original_core_preservation: Each original entire byte stream is an exact suffix after a separately attributable metadata/adoption prefix. Historical receipts, foundation files, models, rules, prompts, firsts, scores, adverse findings and nulls are not edited. Snapshot hashes remain statements about their original commits.
authority_limits: No monograph in this tranche has an explicit perpetual byte-/archival-lock declaration in the reviewed owning records. Explicitly immutable tested models are excluded and require separate disposition; no authority state is assigned merely to pass validation.
